visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An ANA (All Nippon Airways) Boeing 787 airplane is parked at a terminal gate under clear daylight; the white fuselage reflects the sun while a boarding bridge is attached to the cabin door. Transitioning to Tokyo Station, its glass facade and prominent sign are visible as pedestrians walk across the paved entrance and a black sedan drives past in the foreground. A wide urban panorama follows, featuring the red and white Tokyo Tower standing tall against a vast grey city skyline under an overcast sky. (2) The scene shifts to the entrance of a theme park with large archways where a diverse crowd of visitors, including children and adults, move toward the gates amidst festive decorations. A mascot character, Pluto, is seen in a close-up interacting with people while a white text box with a detailed list of information overlays the center of the frame. A beautiful, ornate castle with multiple pink and grey spires is shown from a low angle. The interior of a modern hotel lobby features high ceilings, a grand piano, sleek furniture, and a person sitting on a plush sofa. (3) Inside a hotel room, two twin beds with white linens are neatly arranged next to a large window offering a scenic city view under natural light. Outside, the historic red-brick Tokyo Station Marunouchi building stands grandly with Japanese flags waving in the breeze as people walk across the open plaza. On a busy city street, a white delivery truck passes while Tokyo Tower looms in the distant background. The final sequence displays a series of narrow Tokyo streets with colorful store signage and pedestrians, concluding with a comprehensive text overlay listing travel service logos and promotional Visa offers.
